_about: Monolith's music, your way. Give any slot a file (MP3, WAV or OGG, relative to this file or a full path) and it plays there; a slot with an empty file, or left out, plays the built-in synthesised music. Read MUSIC.txt for what each slot is and how the fades work. Save this file while the game runs and it is read again within a couple of seconds (it applies at the next music change). The log, Monolith_audio_log.txt, says what was read and names every mistake.
_fields: file | volume (dB, 0 as it is, -6 quieter) | fadeIn, fadeOut (seconds; left out: the slot's own) | loop (true or false) | bpm (the track's tempo, if it starts on the beat: changes then land on its beat or bar; left out: a time-based cross-fade) | beatsPerBar (4) | loopStart, loopEnd (seconds inside the file) | themes only: priority (the higher plays), mode (duck: the base score drops under it; replace: the base goes silent), duck (dB the base drops by)

base._about: The score that follows the fight. Add a mission before the slot to change it for that mission only: "escort/battle2".

stings._about: Short pieces over everything when something arrives or an objective ends. The _battle ones play when the fight is on.

endings._about: Played once when the mission ends. They end every theme.

themes._about: Tracks tied to a moment of a mission. The name is mission/theme ("escort/lector"), or just the theme name for every mission. The numbers below are the built-in themes' own: change them, or give a file.
